name: invoke_agent
description:
invoke_agent:
Run a registered agent and return its structured output.

Use this in task IR tool sequences to call an agent inline without routing through a manager.
The agent uses its own config, prompts, and output schema.

Arguments:
- agent_name: name of the registered agent (e.g. 'headline_extractor', 'sensei::analyst')
- agent_input: dict of key-value pairs that become the agent's blackboard state (maps to Jinja2 template variables)

inputs.name: agent_name
inputs.description: Name of the registered agent to invoke.

inputs.name: agent_input
inputs.description: Dict of key-value pairs unpacked onto the agent's blackboard. Keys map to Jinja2 template variables (e.g. 'task', 'information').

outputs.description: Agent output as text (JSON for structured output agents).
Name of the agent that was invoked.
Agent's structured output (from agent_form.py) or content wrapped in a dict.

arguments_prompt:
Fill arguments for `invoke_agent`.

Return ONLY a JSON object with:
- agent_name (string, required)
- agent_input (object, optional)

Example:
{"agent_name":"sensei::analyst","agent_input":{"task":"Analyze this trace","information":"..."}}
